Rajnath Singh Emphasizes Defence Preparedness Beyond Borders

Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that India's national security strategy must extend beyond traditional geographical boundaries to address evolving threats. He stressed the need to understand changing security challenges and bolster defence preparedness against highly fluid emerging threats, adopting a holistic approach.
